profile.description: Arabian Internet and Communication Services Company offers information communication and technology and other services to healthcare, real estate, education, government, oil and gas, telecom, and banking sectors. It engages in the extension, installation, managing, and monitoring of computer networks, wiring, and communications; road repair, maintenance, and supplies; installation, repair, maintenance, environmental monitoring, and control operation; and provision of system integration, connectivity, business outsourcing, cybersecurity integration, managed, senior management advisory, and engineering consultations services. The company also undertakes manufacturing, assembling, operating, maintenance, electromechanical, and electronic works; designs engineering and scientific systems, computer systems and accessories, Xerox and graphic machines, automatic control devices, wire and wireless communication devices, and spare parts; sells computer software, electronic hardware and device, and supplies and accessories; lease and maintains devices; and designs, supplies, installs, and maintains security, alarm, automatic firefighting, circuit breaker systems, and communication devices, optical ground wire grids, electricity transmission lines, power transformation stations, generators, and auxiliary plants; and supplies, installs, and maintains educational laboratories. It also repairs and maintains engines, systems, and fixed and portable data storage devices; installs and maintains security devices; advises, tests, and measures environmental indicators; operates air laboratories; wholesales environmental monitoring and control systems; implements projects; and designs, supplies, installs, operates, and maintains grids, stations, and booster pumping station. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Arabian Internet and Communication Services Company is a subsidiary of Saudi Telecom Company.
